_comment: Rope candidates for the coherence gate. TARGET POLICY for all MLSys runs:
* Llama-3.1-8B is the target. At 128k and below it runs its NATIVE
* Above 128k, ONLY a rope configuration that passes the gate may be used.
* No training-free YaRN on a 4k-native model. Measured on Llama-2-7B at
32k: correct anchoring still left 4.9x native perplexity and a
generation that collapsed into newline repetition, so training-free
YaRN at large factors is not a usable long-context configuration even
* Stay on transformers 4.47.1 with rope_anchor_base. 4.47.1's YaRN
is routed onto config.max_position_embeddings; the gate asserts the
result from the built model's inv_freq rather than trusting the dict.
* Every run records its effective inv_freq summary in its output.
The two `expected_fail` entries are deliberate negative controls: they are
the constructions the ARM4 ladder actually used, and the gate is only

coherence_gate.name: native_128k
coherence_gate.why: In-distribution reference: ctx == native window, shipped rope preserved.

coherence_gate.name: llama3_f16_256k
coherence_gate.why: Builds ON the native mechanism: copies the shipped llama3 block and only raises factor (8 -> 16). Anchor stays 8192.

coherence_gate.name: yarn_base8192_f32_256k
coherence_gate.why: YaRN anchored on Llama-3.1's true pretraining base (8192) instead of the 131072 window its dict would otherwise claim.

coherence_gate.name: yarn_base131072_f2_256k
coherence_gate.why: NEGATIVE CONTROL: the ARM4 f2 construction (YaRN replacing llama3, anchored on the full window). Must be rejected.

coherence_gate.name: yarn_rebased_on_context_256k
coherence_gate.why: NEGATIVE CONTROL: YaRN replacing llama3 with the anchor left on config.max_position_embeddings (= the context length, 262144), i.e. exactly what the engine did on 4.47.1 before rope_anchor_base existed.

coherence_gate.name: llama3_f32_512k
coherence_gate.note: Native mechanism, only the factor moves 8 -> 32. This is the 512k candidate the approved rung needs; without it the 512k stage has no configuration that can pass the gate, so it would always be skipped.

coherence_gate.name: yarn_base8192_f64_512k
coherence_gate.note: YaRN over the true 8192 pretraining base; the alternative at 512k.
